svg.title: Gas-insulated substation interface — Incoming cable and GIS enclosure
svg.desc: Incoming cable and GIS enclosure. 4 equipment references and 3 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
svg.text: Incoming cable and GIS enclosure · declared connections · illustrative equipment symbols
